title: Power Up
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about things that hurt. Spikes cost a few hit points, and only once. A pool in the ground costs a whole life, and the room starts again where you came in. The third level has a safe way past both. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a hazard.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has three short levels to cross. A patch of spikes stings a little, a pool in the ground is worth a whole life, and the third room has a safe way past both. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a hazard.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Spikes hurt once; a pool costs a life and the room starts again
Made to be copied and taken apart
